source: local FAIR-CSAR-Full-Pose-Ordered PNG and 23-column YOLO labels
source_names_status: legacy mapping retained; original official object-level annotations unavailable
quarantine: five unresolved class-4 source-test images listed in splits/faircsar_local_v1/manifest.csv
box_policy: intersect source xyxy box with normalized image rectangle; encode positive visible intersection as cxcywh

point_policy.off_image: write x=0,y=0,validity=0; do not clamp points to image edges
point_policy.validity_meaning: labelled in-image coordinate, not observed physical visibility

train_val_group: source image prefix; union groups if any PNG bytes are identical
selection_objective: 0.4 relative image-count error + 0.6 mean relative five-class object-count error, using source trainval labels only
test_policy: retain source-test membership except explicit quarantine; derived labels use the same geometry policy as training
images: no resampling, rotation, pixel changes or recompression
comparison: Detect and Pose must have identical image names, object row counts, classes and first five label columns
augmentation_note: Before training, use the same augmentation in all groups; disable flips/rotations until ordered-point correspondence has been verified
benchmark_scope: local curated comparison; not unchanged official FAIR-CSAR metrics and not geographic-domain holdout
